rejected.commons_credit_copy_failed: No compact, independently established term covering creator/source/licence attribution; copying merely sona pi tan would omit licence/creator meaning. Existing full explanatory credit prose does not substantiate a short error caption. Cross-review: Could expand into three explanatory questions, but this compact status still lacks a reviewed cohesive referent for copying attribution; keep fallback.
rejected.commons_import_raster_changes: The literal background=#FFFFFF must remain exact, but alpha compositing is not equivalent to generic adding background. Cannot yet substantiate exact opacity-combination wording for an attribution transformation record. Cross-review: Keeping technical alpha compositing untranslated would be an invariant English insertion, not a new language rendering; simple white backing is not a complete operation description.
rejected.commons_metadata_field_too_large: Attribution field versus entire credit/document distinction is essential to this validation error; no independently substantiated compact field/attribution combination. Cross-review: Single metadata field matters; no evidence supports replacing it with entire attribution text.
rejected.commons_metadata_original_mismatch: Requires specific attribution-to-selected-original binding mismatch, not generic source error. No reliable proposed binding wording; retain fallback to avoid misreporting provenance integrity. Cross-review: Selected original identity binding is necessary; image information broadly matching another image is insufficient.
rejected.commons_svg_png_encode_failed: Blank map means unlabelled geographic map, not empty image. No supported phrase for that exact map variety plus encoding found; generic sitelen ma pi sitelen ala would contradict visible geography. Cross-review: Specific blank geographic map distinguished from empty picture; generic geographic image would drop unlabelled-map qualifier.
rejected.gallery_external_link_no_handler: Prior rejection retained: linja alone may mean cord; nasin tawa lipu would restrict arbitrary external URI to document links. No substantiated general hyperlink/app handler term. Cross-review: Link may target app-specific URI, not a page/file exclusively. No concise hyperlink relation established.
rejected.legacy_credits_existing: Needs source identity plus associated credit text preservation, not merely prior metadata existence. Compact credit terminology unresolved; avoid losing unchanged-text guarantee. Cross-review: Existing source-specific credit text retained is stronger than generic image info preserved; could mislead provenance behaviour.
rejected.ui_an_image_cannot_attach_to_itself_or_o: Attachment dependency and recursive descendant are not ordinary spatial adjacency. Need wording identifying transitive attached image without implying only direct neighbour; no substantiated proposal. Cross-review: Source has recursive graph cycle detection. Direct adjacency wording fails descendants, so retain.
rejected.ui_catrobat_online_gallery_artwork_by_it: Authorship qualification credited creators cannot be reduced to Catrobat authorship or generic source; dormant attribution sentence awaiting exact terminology. Cross-review: Credited creators cannot be replaced by Catrobat or unspecified makers; dormant but factual attribution still requires precision.
rejected.ui_could_not_export_source_code: No accepted exact term for program source code distinct from source image or generic instructions; proposed nasin ilo could imply settings rather than executable source. Cross-review: Code distinct from settings/build assets remains insufficiently supported; not just absence of active references.
rejected.ui_drag_across_the_ellipse_s_bounding_bo: Needs drag across bounding rectangle of ellipse, not across ellipse outline. No natural ellipse/bounding-box distinction sufficiently supported by current lexicon. Cross-review: Bounding rectangle is not ellipse perimeter; generic o tawa across oval would teach wrong gesture.
rejected.ui_draw_soft_watercolor_strokes_strength: Watercolor stroke softness and colour blending amount are different from geometric smoothness or transparency. No substantiated wording retaining those distinctions in this tool tip. Cross-review: Blending colour into canvas differs from alpha strength or spatial blur; no precise paired formulation established.
rejected.ui_export_this_version_s_source_code: Program source-code export and exact current-version qualifier need supported terminology distinct from settings/source images; preserve fallback rather than vague nasin ilo. Cross-review: Version-qualified source bundle, not all source or configuration; code term issue remains.
rejected.ui_gallery_artwork_catrobat_and_its_cred: Legal attribution/adaptation obligations with exception for separately identified terms; uncertain creator/licence/adaptation wording could change duties. No paraphrase proposed. Cross-review: Separate-terms exception and modifications disclosure are operative duties, unsupported shortening would alter scope.
rejected.ui_help23: Specific unresolved segments: selection vs inserted floating object, save-destination persistence, export-without-marking-saved, and vertical-script handling. Translating only familiar clauses would leave misleading partial manual; cannot accept entire value until those distinct semantics have reviewed wording. Cross-review: Read complete English value. Precise save/export state, transparent floating image selection and exact palette control distinctions remain unreviewed; incomplete translation cannot replace this whole value.
rejected.ui_hue_and_saturation_spectrum_lightness: Hue, saturation and lightness are separate colour-model quantities. Generic colour/brightness wording would collapse channels; need precise independently supported terms. Cross-review: Hue/saturation/lightness distinct channels; broad kule brightness cannot distinguish them.
rejected.ui_icons_artwork: Two distinct asset categories icons and artwork; sitelen lili en sitelen would obscure role distinction and cannot imply icon size alone. No verified technical category terms. Cross-review: Small images versus artwork is not icon functional-role distinction; no new exact category phrase established.
rejected.ui_image_credits: Compact attribution label unresolved: must encompass creator/source/licence, not only image origin. Long prior explanatory sentences do not validate short term. Cross-review: Short heading must include creator/source/licence attribution, not just author or origin. Long explanations are not equivalent compact headings.
rejected.ui_invalid_image_attachments: Graph attachment validity includes dependencies/cycles, not merely bad spatial placement. No supported concise technical wording for this graph relation. Cross-review: Source validates mutually exclusive exact placement/attachment plus dependency graph; generic invalid position omits graph relation.
rejected.ui_no_gallery_images_have_been_inserted: Actual English means no available credit text, not absent gallery images despite key name. Credit-text term unresolved; reject semantic shortcut based on key. Cross-review: Read English and consumer: unavailable credit text, not no images. No concise reviewed available-credit-text term; do not follow misleading key.
rejected.ui_openclipart_help34: Openclipart publishes under CC0 plus exact saved-provenance navigation. Legal-source designation and uncertain short credit/licence labels require precise review; do not reduce CC0 to free use. Cross-review: Need exact Large PNG/Use image control and saved licence/source navigation. Those do not all have reviewed matching labels; CC0 cannot be simplified to unrestricted use.
rejected.ui_pencil_crisp_adjustable_strokes: Crisp raster edges distinct from stroke smoothness/sharp shape; cannot substantiate wording for edge sampling independent of width without confusing antialiasing setting. Cross-review: Preserve hard raster edge at arbitrary width versus geometry smoothness; generic clear/sharp inadequate.
rejected.ui_sans_medium: Sans-serif family and medium weight are distinct typographic classification; medium not simply middle size. No validated exact terminology. Cross-review: Medium is font weight, not size or position; serif-class wording not established.
rejected.ui_smooth_pixel_edges_anti_aliasing: Anti-aliasing changes pixel-edge coverage, not freehand stroke smoothing. Proposed generic smooth/pona conflates separate toggles; no independently justified technical wording. Cross-review: Must distinguish anti-aliasing from nearby freehand smoothing toggle; generic smooth edges risks merging settings.
rejected.ui_source_code_exported_including_build_: Source code, build scripts and licence notices are three distinct exported categories. No verified exact terms; cannot safely claim generic instructions preserve these assurances. Cross-review: Program source, build instructions and licence notices need distinct referents; general instructions insufficient.
rejected.ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_below_: Audited long manual: exact transparent floating-selection/opaque-document distinction, source-credit legal notice, save-vs-export document state, transitive assembly attachment reflow and joining-script controls remain unresolved. Not rejected for length; these concrete semantics prevent a fully correct single string, and partial translation would lose stated guarantees. Cross-review: Reviewed actual full manual. Unresolved exact credits, floating selection/save state, joining glyph orientation and dependent attachment semantics prevent complete faithful replacement; length itself is not blocker.
rejected.ui_the_attachment_image_is_not_placed: Prior rejected attachment relation remains unresolved; simple sitelen li lon ala ma pali loses the dependency-image referent. No substantiated correction, so retain fallback. Cross-review: Actual resolve recursion refers required dependency not in placement; dropping dependency referent would misidentify current image. Proposed plain not-placed phrase remains rejected.
rejected.ui_too_many_gallery_redirects: Redirect means HTTP hop to another URL, not image movement or retries. Previous hyperlink ambiguity unresolved; retain technical fallback. Cross-review: Redirect is HTTP destination hop, not retries or pan; generic repeated open would misdiagnose failure.
rejected.ui_vertical_sideways23: Rotated glyph orientation while preserving script joining is not simply sideways word order. No proven concise phrase preserving both rotation and joining semantics; avoid claiming all letters stay upright or reversing order. Cross-review: Sideways rotation plus joined scripts must both survive; simple side direction or grouped words not equivalent.
rejected.colour20_stored_slot: Instruction quotes Replace but no independently established corresponding short translated control is available; source consumer is currently dormant. Do not substitute the existing long replace-palette explanation for a button name.
rejected.commons_credit_copy_failed_reason: Credit includes creator/source/licence information; short jan pali alone would narrow it. A full explanatory expansion exists but insertion before a dynamic failure reason is insufficiently reviewed for this status context.
rejected.formats22_previous_page: Earlier temporal phrasing remains rejected: previous page is adjacent index in PDF/TIFF and credit pagination, not past-time page. No concise independently defensible immediate-predecessor label established.
rejected.gallery_copy_credit: Cannot narrow structured author/source/licence credit to author only; lengthy explanatory wording unsuitable for this injected compact button and dialog action without further design review.
rejected.legacy_credits_hint: Must preserve stale credit records potentially belonging to other images, per-source association, and full-text export. Current short terms collapse source vs credit vs file; no sufficiently precise whole workflow proposal in this pass.
rejected.ui_about_copyright: Copyright must distinguish exclusive legal rights from generic use rules; no concise supported term in this two-part action label. Existing about label is not proof of equivalence.
rejected.ui_catrobat_s_own_artwork_uses_cc_by_sa: Specific creator-credit/share-alike/separate-attribution duties plus exact navigation path require mutually consistent menu and licence terminology. Cannot preserve them confidently with current vocabulary; this is a per-key legal/navigation precision rejection, not a blanket legal-text stop.
rejected.ui_common_in: Two arbitrary dynamic terms and no direct consumer; cannot determine whether common means shared dimension, frequency, or unit-specific common value. Context insufficient, not a language-wide rejection.
rejected.ui_creator_on_source34: Dormant source contributor instruction; source page term supportable, but contributor can differ from creator and could mean uploader. Existing evidence does not resolve intended scope sufficiently.
rejected.ui_current_safe_editing_budget_s_up_to_2: Must explicitly distinguish safe resident editing budget and megapixel limit before decoder overhead. A natural compact rendering of excluded overhead not sufficiently supported; omitting it would change a safety-relevant qualifier.
rejected.ui_drag_from_the_tail_towards_the_arrowh: Arrow tail/head must identify opposite geometric ends, not animal tail/head or arbitrary corners. No precise natural endpoint wording independently supported; existing arrow label alone does not establish those relations.
rejected.ui_drag_to_pan_without_drawing_pinch_wit: Gesture requires drag-pan, two-finger pinch zoom and two-finger pan working with drawing tools. Palisa alone for finger and vague lili/suli gestures risk reversing or omitting mechanics; no complete confident wording.
rejected.ui_hue_and_saturation_wheel_value_slider: Must distinguish HSV hue/saturation from value and locate slider right. Generic colour strength/brightness conflates saturation/value; exact labels not sufficiently supported.
rejected.ui_icons_fonts_artwork_credits: Compact multi-asset credits label must cover fonts, icon work and attribution. Current terms for fonts and attribution remain ambiguous; do not silently reduce to artist names.
rejected.ui_irasutoya_credit34: Must preserve copyright retention, conditional use subject to Irasutoya terms, and explicit not-CC statement. No verified compact copyright rendering; generic creator ownership would materially narrow legal meaning.
rejected.ui_same: Dynamic arbitrary noun unspecified and no exact current consumer. Fixed same-width/same-height already exist; do not guess grammar ordering of arbitrary inserted term.
rejected.ui_sans_serif: Retaining Sans serif is not Toki Pona descriptive translation; a serif-free shape description needs typographic-specific precision not supported here. Leave existing fallback rather than label identical text as language gain.
rejected.ui_spectrum: Advanced colour spectrum differs from wheel and palette; kulupu kule would collapse controls, and simple kule mute does not distinguish gradient spectrum. No concise defensible technical label established.
rejected.ui_the_gallery_download_is_too_large: Prior rejection retained: needs downloaded byte-count too large, not physical dimensions. Generic sona mute proposal still lacks clear permitted size bound in compact status; do not claim revised acceptance without independent evidence.
rejected.ui_the_online_gallery_could_not_be_loade: Prior rejection retained: network connection check must not become information cord/line or generic knowledge check. No externally supported or independently reviewed network-connection term found.
rejected.ui_vertical_upright23: Upright glyph-by-glyph orientation must contrast mixed and sideways modes, not simply vertical flow or individual character selection. No precise concise unrotated-glyph term independently established.
rejected.ui_you_can_add_more_images_select_fewer_: Prior rejection retained: must explicitly say remaining additional capacity and reduce selection, not delete files or merely want few files. Current vocabulary still does not reliably encode all three relations compactly.
rejected.ui_pencil_keeps_crisp_one_pixel_strokes_: Draft seli ala means unheated rather than crisp/pixel edges; no reliable natural antialiasing-edge wording. Reject individually, do not manufacture a term.
rejected.formats22_base64_description: Cross-review: losslessness and literal header are retained, but final clauses state PNG needs little storage and Base64 needs much storage rather than strictly larger than its contained PNG. No precise natural comparative byte/storage expression established here; cannot silently broaden relative size to absolute size.
rejected.ui_copy_decoded_image_at_this_size_estim: Cross-review: nanpa pi sona pini ala reads as unfinished knowledge, not an estimate. Decoded-image bytes must also be distinguished from source file information. Safety-relevant memory labels cannot lose both qualifiers.
rejected.ui_original_decoded_image_rgba_4_bytes_p: Cross-review: same estimate ambiguity; sona pi sitelen open could be original metadata rather than decoded bitmap allocation. Preserve fallback rather than mislabel measured and estimated RAM.
rejected.ui_cursor_ink30: Cross-review: sitelen lili alone denotes small image, not cursor; existing similar wording is context not validation. This dormant label cannot be accepted merely by extending ambiguous lexicon.
rejected.ui_drag_between_opposite_corners_choose_: Cross-review: nena means protrusion/bump/button and does not identify geometric corners. nena pi poka ante is not securely the diagonally opposite corner; would alter rectangle drag instruction.
rejected.ui_gallery_unsupported34: Cross-review: ma sitelen pi wile sina identifies a desired image place, not selected provider/source. Failure concerns URI membership in selected provider, not user preference; exact referent unsupported.
rejected.save20_bmp_size_limit: Cross-review: sona pi sitelen ni li mute ike can mean too much image information, not file byte-size limit. Need explicit file-size restriction distinct from dimensions and content complexity.
rejected.ui_some_previews_could_not_be_decoded_yo: Cross-review: alasa awen sona lacks clear try-to-save grammar, and open ala alone risks did-not-open versus decode failure. No confidently precise full diagnostic/action pair established.
rejected.commons_blank_maps: Blank-map geographical outline versus empty drawing is not reliably expressed by current basic sitelen vocabulary; avoid misleading empty-file label.
rejected.commons_credit_copy_out_of_memory: Attribution credit includes creators, sources and licence; a compact unambiguous referent for what cannot be copied is not established in this RAM error context.
rejected.commons_metadata_ambiguous_file: Need preserve ambiguous file-identity response, not simply invalid/missing file; no defensible compact technical expression established.
rejected.commons_metadata_invalid_page: Must distinguish invalid attribution page from a generally bad document. Current vocabulary does not securely identify attribution metadata.
rejected.commons_metadata_response_too_large: Response byte limit is distinct from image dimensions and RAM; no precise data-volume expression substantiated.
rejected.formats22_ico_description: Compression, single icon, centering and aspect ratio require exact technical relationships. Can describe some clauses but cannot preserve full meaning confidently.
rejected.formats22_next_page: Temporal next-time wording was previously rejected; next page in ordered document cannot safely be equated with future page. No corrected ordering expression established.
rejected.formats22_pdf_encrypted: Must preserve password requirement versus unsupported encryption and unprotected-copy advice. Cannot reliably convey encryption without inventing a technical term.
rejected.formats22_pdf_page_count: Prior rejection retained: same lipu for PDF container and internal pages plus bounded count risks ambiguity; no validated document/page distinction.
rejected.gallery_credit_copied: Short credit label needs attribution meaning, not praise or money; existing long explanatory clauses are not a supported compact action result.
rejected.gallery_credit_publisher: Publisher is not necessarily creator. Describing Catrobat as maker would change attribution role; precise publisher-role wording unsupported.
rejected.gallery_description: Each licensing obligation, separately named creators, adaptation notice and compatible share-alike licence must remain exact. No defensible complete rendering of these specific distinctions established.
rejected.legacy_credits_add: Selected attribution record and association with this document must be distinguished from adding visual credit text; concise precise wording unsupported.
rejected.legacy_credits_save_text: Selected attribution record as text differs from saving image or generic acknowledgement; no precise supported short referent for credit record.
rejected.ui_about_copyright_licence: Copyright rights and licence permission are legally different; a single general lawa term would erase distinction.
